facts: BodyFacingTurn retains policy operands (speed, positivehalfturn duration, or deadline angle/duration), rather than separately storing derived rate. Complete native quotient→elapsed product→pi cap intentionally permits transient rate infinity; it is not an admitted cached speed. Configured wrappers read installed config; controller/root/body forward conventions explicitly differ and use one native yaw adapter.

DownedFacingState separates target sticky sector, continuous unwrapped interpolation coordinate and last observed lateral motion. Body contact parity updates only at actual whole-contact boundary. These are independent commanded/current/history facts, so a target/current difference during turn is intentional. Wire normalization is deliberately a different raw observation boundary from strict scalar constructors. P16 held/released and tie parity policy reads current transition config once for selection; no duplicated writable discrete sector cache outside private state identified here. Large-coordinate arithmetic/saturation needs actual operation/admission finding, not a category-only redundant-authority claim.
